{{Quote|It's time to send an emissary to the New Republic. To discuss the terms of our surrender.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ardiff]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
The following events took place in '''19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Ishori]]&ndash;[[Diamal]] dispute.<ref name="SotP" />
*[[Caamas Document Crisis]].<ref name="SotP" />
*"[[Sinister Triumvirate|Return]]" of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]<ref name="VOF" />
*The signing of the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty]] on the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] between the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] ended the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The New Republic and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Remnant began a peaceful coexistence.<ref name="VOF" /><ref name="TNEGtC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
*Destruction of the [[Hand of Thrawn]].<ref name="RSBF">{{GamerCite|7|Red Sky, Blue Flame}}</ref>
*[[Wedding of Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade]].<ref name="Union">''[[Star Wars: Union]]''</ref><ref name="TNEGtC" />
*[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] veterans [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] and [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] retired from military service.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="TNEGtC" />
*Separatists from the Imperial Remnant formed the [[Second Imperium]] from the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and carried on [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] legacy even after the Galactic Civil War.
*[[Viqi Shesh]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] was elected to the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="TNEGtC" />
*[[Quarantine of Endregaad]]<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref>
